introHtml: When your team needs to secure badges, keys, or small cards beyond just an ID, custom with zipper badge id holders provide that extra layer of protection. These holders keep contents from falling out during active use on the job or at busy tradeshows. Options like the 3" x 4" Horizontal Vinyl Pouch with Zipper offer a clear window for ID display while the zippered compartment holds cash, cards, or a phone. Choose from horizontal or vertical layouts, and add your logo via screen printing or debossing for a professional look that suits safety managers, event staff, or field workers.
heroAltText: Custom with zipper badge id holders featuring a clear vinyl pouch and secure zipper closure for ID and small items.
